design: A cute comical treasure-chest monster made of warm honey-brown wood, chunky rounded golden bands, a big keyhole like a nose, two large shiny friendly amber cartoon eyes on the lid, a cheerful crooked grin with only a few small rounded ivory teeth and a short pink tongue. Idle blink and lid breathing; hurt surprised squint and startled little lid wobble; attack playful lid snap and tongue flick toward right; dodge rocks back with big surprised eyes. Same eyes and golden bands in every frame.
